facts.coverage: Quarter-end covered long securities under investment discretion; generally U.S.-exchange stocks/ADRs and certain options, warrants and convertibles.

facts.excluded: Short positions and written options; foreign-only listed stocks, private investments, cash and many other assets. Long/short positions must not be netted.
facts.omissions: Small holdings may be omitted only if both under 10,000 shares and under $200,000; confidential treatment can delay disclosure.
facts.aggregation: A manager filing can aggregate several accounts or other included managers. Sole discretion does not identify the individual who selected a position.
